```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE, fig.height=4.8, fig.width=10, out.width="100%"}
# ======================================================
# SES histogram + order-divided pollinator guild heatmap
#
# Panel A:
#   - SES histogram
#   - shaded avoidance/preference regions
#   - reduced height and top alignment
#
# Panel B:
#   - one faceted heatmap
#   - divisions by pollinator order
#   - guilds retained inside each order
#   - visible order icons in a reserved numeric column
#   - one shared plant-family x-axis
# ======================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(cowplot)
library(ggimage)
library(rsvg)
library(grid)

# ======================================================
# General settings
# ======================================================

alpha <- 0.05
critical_value <- qnorm(0.975)
top_n_plants <- 18

region_alpha <- 0.07

# Height of panel A relative to its panel container
ses_relative_height <- 0.80

cat_levels <- c(
  "Avoidance",
  "No difference",
  "Preference"
)

cat_labels <- c(
  "Avoidance",
  "No difference",
  "Preference"
)

plot_cols <- c(
  "Avoidance" = "#F1A340",
  "No difference" = "grey85",
  "Preference" = "#7B3294"
)

# ======================================================
# Pollinator guild definitions
# ======================================================

hymenoptera_guilds <- c(
  "Apidae",
  "Andrenidae",
  "Halictidae",
  "Megachilidae",
  "Colletidae",
  "Melittidae",
  "Non-bee Hymenoptera"
)

diptera_guilds <- c(
  "Bombylids",
  "Syrphids",
  "Other Diptera"
)

lepidoptera_guilds <- "Lepidoptera"
coleoptera_guilds <- "Coleoptera"

guild_order <- c(
  hymenoptera_guilds,
  diptera_guilds,
  lepidoptera_guilds,
  coleoptera_guilds
)

order_levels <- c(
  "Hymenoptera",
  "Diptera",
  "Lepidoptera",
  "Coleoptera"
)

# ======================================================
# Icon files
# ======================================================

icon_svg <- c(
  Hymenoptera = "../icons/bee.svg",
  Diptera = "../icons/fly.svg",
  Lepidoptera = "../icons/butterfly.svg",
  Coleoptera = "../icons/beetle.svg"
)

missing_icons <- icon_svg[
  !file.exists(icon_svg)
]

if (length(missing_icons) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "The following icon files could not be found:\n",
      paste(
        missing_icons,
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  )

}

# Convert SVG files to temporary PNG files.
# PNG output is generally more reliable when rendering PDF.

convert_svg_to_png <- function(
  svg_file,
  icon_name
) {

  png_file <- file.path(
    tempdir(),
    paste0(
      "pollinator_icon_",
      gsub(
        "[^A-Za-z0-9]",
        "_",
        icon_name
      ),
      ".png"
    )
  )

  rsvg_png(
    svg = svg_file,
    file = png_file,
    width = 800,
    height = 800
  )

  png_file
}

icon_png <- vapply(
  names(icon_svg),
  function(icon_name) {

    convert_svg_to_png(
      svg_file = icon_svg[[icon_name]],
      icon_name = icon_name
    )

  },
  character(1)
)

# Check that converted files exist
if (any(!file.exists(icon_png))) {

  stop(
    "One or more SVG icons could not be converted to PNG."
  )

}

# ======================================================
# Load data
# ======================================================

SES_guild <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/SES_guild_split_bees.rds"
)

pval_df_guild <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/pval_df_guild_split_bees.rds"
)

raw_data <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/interaction_data.rds"
)

# ======================================================
# Count pollinator species per guild
# ======================================================

poll_orders <- c(
  "Hymenoptera",
  "Diptera",
  "Coleoptera",
  "Lepidoptera"
)

bee_families <- c(
  "Apidae",
  "Andrenidae",
  "Halictidae",
  "Megachilidae",
  "Colletidae",
  "Melittidae"
)

guild_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Pollinator_accepted_name),
    Pollinator_rank == "SPECIES",
    Pollinator_order %in% poll_orders
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pollinator_guild = case_when(

      Pollinator_order == "Hymenoptera" &
        Pollinator_family %in% bee_families ~
        Pollinator_family,

      Pollinator_order == "Hymenoptera" ~
        "Non-bee Hymenoptera",

      Pollinator_family == "Bombyliidae" ~
        "Bombylids",

      Pollinator_family == "Syrphidae" ~
        "Syrphids",

      Pollinator_order == "Diptera" ~
        "Other Diptera",

      Pollinator_order == "Lepidoptera" ~
        "Lepidoptera",

      Pollinator_order == "Coleoptera" ~
        "Coleoptera",

      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Pollinator_guild)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Pollinator_guild,
    Pollinator_accepted_name
  ) %>%
  count(
    Pollinator_guild,
    name = "n_species"
  )

# ======================================================
# Count plant species per family
# ======================================================

plant_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Plant_family),
    !is.na(Plant_accepted_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Plant_family,
    Plant_accepted_name
  ) %>%
  count(
    Plant_family,
    name = "n_species"
  )

# ======================================================
# A) SES histogram data
# ======================================================

SES_df <- as.data.frame(
  SES_guild
) %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "Plant_family"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Plant_family,
    names_to = "Pollinator_guild",
    values_to = "SES"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SES)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      SES < -critical_value ~
        "Avoidance",

      SES > critical_value ~
        "Preference",

      TRUE ~
        "No difference"
    ),

    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = cat_levels
    )
  )

x_lim <- quantile(
  abs(SES_df$SES),
  probs = 0.85,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

x_lim <- max(
  x_lim,
  critical_value * 1.05
)

# ======================================================
# A) SES histogram
# ======================================================

p_ses <- ggplot(
  SES_df,
  aes(
    x = SES,
    fill = category
  )
) +

  # Avoidance-region shading
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -x_lim,
    xmax = -critical_value,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = unname(
      plot_cols["Avoidance"]
    ),
    alpha = region_alpha
  ) +

  # Preference-region shading
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = critical_value,
    xmax = x_lim,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = unname(
      plot_cols["Preference"]
    ),
    alpha = region_alpha
  ) +

  geom_histogram(
    bins = 1100,
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.9,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      -critical_value,
      critical_value
    ),
    linetype = "longdash",
    colour = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    colour = "#3B3B3B",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_cols,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(
      -x_lim,
      x_lim
    ),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "a)",
    x = "Standardized effect size (SES)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +

  theme_bw(
    base_size = 13
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.9
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 12,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 1,
      r = 2,
      b = 1,
      l = 1
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# B) Heatmap data
# ======================================================

heat_df <- as.data.frame(
  SES_guild
) %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "Plant_family"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Plant_family,
    names_to = "Pollinator_guild",
    values_to = "SES"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pval_df_guild,
    by = c(
      "Plant_family",
      "Pollinator_guild"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SES),
    Pollinator_guild %in% guild_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pollinator_order_group = case_when(

      Pollinator_guild %in%
        hymenoptera_guilds ~
        "Hymenoptera",

      Pollinator_guild %in%
        diptera_guilds ~
        "Diptera",

      Pollinator_guild ==
        "Lepidoptera" ~
        "Lepidoptera",

      Pollinator_guild ==
        "Coleoptera" ~
        "Coleoptera",

      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    ),

    category = case_when(

      p_two < alpha &
        SES > 0 ~
        "Avoidance",

      p_two < alpha &
        SES < 0 ~
        "Preference",

      TRUE ~
        "No difference"
    ),

    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = cat_levels
    ),

    Pollinator_order_group = factor(
      Pollinator_order_group,
      levels = order_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(
      Pollinator_order_group
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# Select plant families with strongest SES signal
# ======================================================

plant_keep <- heat_df %>%
  group_by(
    Plant_family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    signal = sum(
      abs(SES),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = signal,
    n = top_n_plants,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  pull(
    Plant_family
  )

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  filter(
    Plant_family %in%
      plant_keep
  )

# ======================================================
# Cluster plant families
# ======================================================

ses_mat <- heat_df %>%
  select(
    Plant_family,
    Pollinator_guild,
    SES
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from =
      Pollinator_guild,
    values_from = SES,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(
    "Plant_family"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

if (nrow(ses_mat) > 1) {

  plant_order <- rownames(
    ses_mat
  )[
    hclust(
      dist(ses_mat)
    )$order
  ]

} else {

  plant_order <- rownames(
    ses_mat
  )

}

# ======================================================
# Species-count labels
# ======================================================

guild_labels <- guild_n_species %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      Pollinator_guild,
      " (",
      n_species,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Pollinator_guild,
    label
  ) %>%
  deframe()

plant_labels <- plant_n_species %>%
  filter(
    Plant_family %in%
      plant_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      Plant_family,
      " (",
      n_species,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Plant_family,
    label
  ) %>%
  deframe()

# Fallback guild labels

missing_guild_labels <- setdiff(
  unique(
    heat_df$Pollinator_guild
  ),
  names(guild_labels)
)

if (
  length(
    missing_guild_labels
  ) > 0
) {

  guild_labels <- c(
    guild_labels,
    setNames(
      missing_guild_labels,
      missing_guild_labels
    )
  )

}

# Fallback plant labels

missing_plant_labels <- setdiff(
  plant_order,
  names(plant_labels)
)

if (
  length(
    missing_plant_labels
  ) > 0
) {

  plant_labels <- c(
    plant_labels,
    setNames(
      missing_plant_labels,
      missing_plant_labels
    )
  )

}

# ======================================================
# Numeric positions for the heatmap
#
# x = 0.28 is reserved for the order icons.
# Plant families begin at x = 1.
# ======================================================

plant_position_df <- tibble(
  Plant_family = plant_order,
  plant_x = seq_along(
    plant_order
  ),
  plant_label = unname(
    plant_labels[
      plant_order
    ]
  )
)

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  left_join(
    plant_position_df,
    by = "Plant_family"
  )

# ======================================================
# Guild-factor ordering
# ======================================================

guilds_present <- guild_order[
  guild_order %in%
    unique(
      heat_df$Pollinator_guild
    )
]

# Reverse because discrete y axes are plotted bottom-to-top
guild_levels_plot <- rev(
  guilds_present
)

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    Pollinator_guild_label =
      factor(
        Pollinator_guild,
        levels =
          guild_levels_plot,
        labels =
          unname(
            guild_labels[
              guild_levels_plot
            ]
          )
      )
  )

# ======================================================
# Icon positions
#
# Each order icon is positioned on the central guild row
# of its corresponding facet.
# ======================================================

middle_guild <- function(
  guilds
) {

  available <- guilds[
    guilds %in%
      guilds_present
  ]

  if (
    length(available) == 0
  ) {

    return(
      NA_character_
    )

  }

  available[
    ceiling(
      length(available) / 2
    )
  ]
}

icon_guilds <- c(
  Hymenoptera = middle_guild(
    hymenoptera_guilds
  ),

  Diptera = middle_guild(
    diptera_guilds
  ),

  Lepidoptera = middle_guild(
    lepidoptera_guilds
  ),

  Coleoptera = middle_guild(
    coleoptera_guilds
  )
)

# Larger values than before, so icons remain visible
icon_sizes <- c(
  Hymenoptera = 0.115,
  Diptera = 0.105,
  Lepidoptera = 0.100,
  Coleoptera = 0.100
)

icon_df <- tibble(
  Pollinator_order_group =
    factor(
      names(icon_guilds),
      levels = order_levels
    ),

  Pollinator_guild =
    unname(
      icon_guilds
    ),

  icon_x = 0.28,

  image = unname(
    icon_png[
      names(icon_guilds)
    ]
  ),

  icon_size = unname(
    icon_sizes[
      names(icon_guilds)
    ]
  )
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(
      Pollinator_guild
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pollinator_guild_label =
      factor(
        Pollinator_guild,
        levels =
          guild_levels_plot,
        labels =
          unname(
            guild_labels[
              guild_levels_plot
            ]
          )
      )
  )

# ======================================================
# B) Faceted heatmap
# ======================================================

p_heat <- ggplot() +

  # Heatmap tiles
  geom_tile(
    data = heat_df,
    aes(
      x = plant_x,
      y =
        Pollinator_guild_label,
      fill = category
    ),
    width = 1,
    height = 1,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # Order icons in the reserved area at x = 0.28
  geom_image(
    data = icon_df,
    aes(
      x = icon_x,
      y =
        Pollinator_guild_label,
      image = image,
      size = icon_size
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    asp = 1
  ) +

  scale_size_identity() +

  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(
      Pollinator_order_group
    ),
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    drop = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_cols,
    breaks = cat_levels,
    labels = cat_labels,
    name =
      "Observed against null",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      length(plant_order) +
        0.5
    ),

    breaks = seq_along(
      plant_order
    ),

    labels = unname(
      plant_labels[
        plant_order
      ]
    ),

    expand = expansion(
      mult = 0
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    position = "right",
    expand = expansion(
      mult = 0
    ),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "b)",
    x = "Plant family",
    y = "Pollinator guild"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "on"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 13
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),

    panel.spacing.y = unit(
      0.13,
      "cm"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 9,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 9,
      colour = "black",
      margin = margin(
        l = 2
      )
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(
        t = 6
      )
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(
        l = 8
      )
    ),

    axis.ticks.x =
      element_blank(),

    # Hide order-name facet labels
    strip.text.y =
      element_blank(),

    strip.background =
      element_blank(),

    legend.position = "none",

    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(
        b = 2
      )
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 1,
      r = 1,
      b = 1,
      l = 1
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# Shared legend
# ======================================================

legend_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(
    category = factor(
      cat_levels,
      levels = cat_levels
    )
  ),
  aes(
    x = category,
    fill = category
  )
) +

  geom_bar(
    alpha = 0
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_cols,
    breaks = cat_levels,
    labels = cat_labels,
    name =
      "Observed against null",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      override.aes = list(
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    legend.key.size = unit(
      0.48,
      "cm"
    ),

    legend.background =
      element_rect(
        colour = "black",
        fill = "white",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ),

    legend.box.background =
      element_rect(
        colour = "black",
        fill = "white",
        linewidth = 1
      ),

    legend.box.margin =
      margin(
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0
      ),

    legend.margin = margin(
      t = 3,
      r = 5,
      b = 5,
      l = 5
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 0,
      b = 1,
      l = 0
    )
  )

shared_legend <- get_legend(
  legend_plot
)

# ======================================================
# Panel A: remove legend
# ======================================================

p_ses_noleg <- p_ses +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = "none"
  )

# ======================================================
# Panel A: shorter and top aligned
# ======================================================

p_ses_short <- ggdraw() +

  draw_plot(
    p_ses_noleg,
    x = 0,
    y =
      1 -
      ses_relative_height,
    width = 1,
    height =
      ses_relative_height
  )

# ======================================================
# Combine panels
# ======================================================

plots_row <- plot_grid(
  p_ses_short,
  p_heat,
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(
    1,
    1.68
  ),
  align = "h",
  axis = "t"
)

# ======================================================
# Final figure
# ======================================================

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  plots_row,
  shared_legend,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(
    1,
    0.12
  )
)

combined_plot
```
